metadata.description: Cross-domain thinking, multi-model tooling, and developer productivity plugins for Claude Code.

plugins.name: distill
plugins.description: Iteratively decompose complex systems into their essential primitives.

plugins.name: lateral-thinking
plugins.description: Generate non-obvious hypotheses by decomposing a problem to its mechanism and raiding distant fields.

plugins.name: codex-exec
plugins.description: Run the Codex CLI for non-interactive coding work. Second opinions, adversarial review, and multi-model consensus.

plugins.name: mp
plugins.description: Matt Pocock-inspired workflows grouped under /mp:* commands, backed by internal plugin modules instead of standalone skill packages.

plugins.name: agent-browser
plugins.description: Browser automation CLI for AI agents. Navigate pages, fill forms, click buttons, take screenshots, extract data.

plugins.name: bun-expert
plugins.description: Expert guidance for JavaScript/TypeScript development with the Bun runtime. Covers setup, servers, APIs, testing, bundling, and Node.js migration.

plugins.name: claude
plugins.description: Run Claude Code CLI for code analysis and automated edits. Delegate tasks, continue sessions, get machine-readable output.

plugins.name: cli-design-expert
plugins.description: Design or review command-line interfaces for usability and automation: help text, flags, exit codes, TTY behavior.

plugins.name: code
plugins.description: Grouped coding workflows under /code:* commands: goal, review-and-commit, explain, try, simplify, walkthrough, understand, dead-code, scratch, socratic-owner, and secure-dependencies.

plugins.name: human-writer
plugins.description: Edit prose so it sounds natural, specific, and human-written. Use when a draft feels generic or model-generated.

plugins.name: improve-prompt
plugins.description: Improve vague or underspecified prompts into sharp, reusable prompts for planning, coding, review, and decision work.

plugins.name: pi
plugins.description: Claude-native planner/generator/evaluator harness for long-running engineering work, with /pi:debate for structured architecture debate.

plugins.name: visualize
plugins.description: Generate a self-contained HTML visualization to explain a system, plan, code flow, or concept.
